description: Use one LoRA on image generation, or add an unambiguous public Hugging Face LoRA and then use it. Does not generate an image or spend money. Pass a project alias, registered name, adapter id, or the same query hydracept_suggest_lora returned. Pass file_path only after a suggestion says to choose a weights file. Pass base_model_family only after a suggestion says the base model is missing. Pass refresh=true only when the suggestion says a newer commit is available. When inputPatch is present, pass inputPatch.adapters on image.generate.v1. Do not fill adapter ids, file paths, or base-model families yourself.
name: hydracept_use_lora
title: Use a LoRA
